description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: Finish checkout and see a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in with <a customer account that can place an order>. The cart contains <at least one item in the cart>. The tester has <any checkout details the application requires, e.g. delivery address and payment details> ready.
steps: Enter the checkout details required by the application using <any checkout details the application requires, e.g. delivery address and payment details>.
cases.expected: Checkout is finished and a confirmation is displayed to the user. The exact content and wording of the confirmation is not specified in the story.
